tests.assertion: test('4923全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP及原生2119全部17招用招，不伪造未答蜃楼映射',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});
